doc.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers
title: Pittsburgh and Pennsylvania as a source of jazz talent
summary: Brown and Golson list musicians from Pittsburgh and Pennsylvania, including Blakey, Clarke, Eckstine, Mary Lou Williams and Strayhorn.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, and I didn’t know that. Same ilk, from Pittsburgh.
Must be something there too. Must be in the coal mines or something.

Pittsburgh turned out – people usually think of Philadelphia and Detroit, but Pittsburgh turned out quite a few. You remind me of the Turrentine brothers, and Erroll Garner, and you had mentioned . . .
Yeah. I didn’t know about that. Incredible.
Something in Philadelphia – I mean in Pennsylvania.
There must be something. A mother lode or something.
Like I told, when Art said, “What is this Philadelphia stuff?” I said, “We’re all from Pennsylvania.”
